message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: In 2014, defendant A (阿某1) together with others premeditated. Leaf (叶某) lured A2 and his daughter from Henan to Anhui. Yu1 (余1某) through others sold A2 and his daughter to Y1 (尹1某) in Hebei as wife. Y1's brother Y2 paid Yu1 and A 9000 yuan. Leaf got 1400 yuan, A1, Yu1, A etc each got 1000 yuan, remaining money wasted.

Thus crimes: kidnapping (illegal detention/abduction) of A2 and his daughter. Also trafficking of persons (selling them as wives). Possibly "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" (trafficking of women and children). Also "组织、领导、参加黑社会性质组织" not indicated. Also "诈骗" maybe not. The act of selling for money is "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" under Chinese criminal law. Also "非法拘禁罪" maybe. Also "强迫卖淫" not indicated. So likely charges: "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" (human trafficking) and "非法拘禁罪". Also "诈骗" no. Also "盗窃" no. Also "诈骗" not.

Thus answer: [罪名]拐卖妇女、儿童罪;非法拘禁罪<eoa>

Thus final.
